verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents loading custom tools via MCP: you integrate "custom business tools" by connecting any MCP server, configured in librechat.yaml or added at runtime from the MCP Settings panel. A Skills feature page and Agent Skills management also exist, and a community user reports that plugins/functions work well on a self-hosted instance. missing for 10: a LibreChat-specific authoring guide or spec for writing a skill/plugin (the Skills page is evidenced only by its title), a documented skill file format, and hands-on corroboration of building and loading a custom tool.
